listing.name: League of Geeks (EN Translation)
listing.summary: Enjoy a rough G Translate / DeepL translation version of the League of Geeks provided by one of the CN Authors.
listing.aiSummary: Adds an energy-focused faction and rebel subfaction featuring crystal-themed weapons, ships, and missions.

description: Provides an English translation of a Chinese mod adding an energy-focused faction and its rebel subfaction. Includes missions, MagicLib bounties, and unique upgrading systems centered around crystals. Features crystal beams, missiles, mechas, and extensive visual effects.
